description: Hand-made on the premises and stamped with the house mark: a circle worn flat on one side. Nothing clever about it — a straight, honest, slightly overweight shortsword that will outlast the person who buys it. Vessa makes about one a week and will not be hurried.
name: Grind House shortsword
